note: Every row here is something a reader must not silently assume. Blank cells are intentional.

flags.item: Standings render without a text header row
flags.finding: The NFL.com division standings table displayed no header text, and the field order does not match the page legend order. Division record and conference record are named in the legend but their displayed position could not be confirmed; four further middle fields are also unidentified. Six of sixteen displayed fields were therefore not transcribed.
flags.impact: Division and conference detail is unavailable on this site. Retained fields were the ones confirmable by arithmetic.

flags.item: Blank game status for 17 of 20 listed players
flags.finding: The official listing shows a blank 'Game Status' for most players while still listing practice participation. The page does not explain, row by row, whether blank means available.
flags.impact: No player is treated as available or unavailable beyond the two Out and one Questionable entries.

flags.item: No depth chart or snap count retrieved
flags.finding: NFL.com's depth-chart address returned a 404 to the reader. No published starter list and no snap share was obtained.
flags.impact: The starter-versus-backup and second/third-string requirement is documented but NOT measured. Every depth field is blank.

flags.item: Home-field adjustment is an assumption
flags.finding: A single 2.0-point home adjustment is applied to all 14 fixtures, including the Munich international game which is not a true home game for either club.
flags.impact: Every originated spread inherits this assumption. No official NFL home-field value was retrieved.

flags.item: No market price exists in the record
flags.finding: No sportsbook line, price, limit or hold for these NFL markets was retrieved, so ROI, CLV and break-even comparisons are blank.
flags.impact: No originated number is claimed to beat the market.

flags.item: Source-use restriction
flags.finding: NFL.com terms 1.3 permit individual non-commercial informational use and prohibit systematic retrieval to compile a collection without written consent.
flags.impact: No dataset is released, nothing is automated against NFL.com, and the site is a frozen attributed note.

flags.item: Single-source values
flags.finding: Every number in this section comes from one retrieved page. Arithmetic re-derivation catches contradictions, not a wrong page.
flags.impact: All values are labelled single-source. A two-source rule is proposed (S10).

flags.item: Five of ten team correlations are not independent evidence
flags.finding: Net points, wins and the record-versus-expectation residual share inputs by construction. Those pairs are labelled on the correlation page rather than removed.
flags.impact: Only five pairs are presented as exploratory evidence.

flags.item: One partial season and one game of injury data
flags.finding: Clubs have played eight or nine games. The injury snapshot covers only the Thursday fixture.
flags.impact: No forward predictive claim is made and coverage fails its gate.

flags.item: Game results were deliberately not transcribed
flags.finding: The score pages rendered some finals as 'Hidden Score' in the reader. Rather than guess, no game-level results were stored, so no historical grading is offered.
flags.impact: No backtest exists. This is a coverage decision, not an oversight.

flags.item: Two-source rule not met
flags.finding: No value here is confirmed by an independent second official source.
flags.impact: Confidence is limited to what one official page supports.

flags.item: NBA section retained alongside NFL
flags.finding: The repository already contained a completed NBA audit and rental research. The NFL section becomes the landing page; the earlier pages remain reachable and keep their own limits.
flags.impact: Nothing from the earlier work was deleted or relabelled as NFL data.

flags.item: A completed game's result is printed, so 'no result exists' is no longer true
flags.finding: The 2026-11-12 register recorded that score pages rendered only 'Hidden Score', so no result was transcribed. On 2026-11-13 the schedule page prints 'Commanders 24, Giants 21, FINAL' in the fixture link text while still printing 'Hidden Score' in both score banners. The publisher contradicts itself on one page.
flags.impact: The frozen snapshot keeps no result, as recorded. The re-check page quotes both strings and records 24-21 only because it is the one reading consistent with the same day's standings arithmetic. No model is scored on it.

flags.item: Two clubs' records moved after the snapshot date
flags.finding: WAS was 2-5-1 with 172 PF / 202 PA on 2026-11-12 and is 3-5-1 with 196 PF / 223 PA on 2026-11-13. NYG moved the other way, 5-2-1 / 182 / 172 to 5-3-1 / 203 / 196. The deltas are a consistent 24-21 result. 30 of 32 rows are unchanged.
flags.impact: The published table is a 2026-11-12 snapshot and says so. A reader comparing it with today's page will see a difference; the re-check page lists all 32 rows side by side so nothing looks silently stale.

flags.item: League depth-chart path still returns no chart; one club path returns 404
flags.finding: https://www.nfl.com/teams/depth-chart serves no league-wide chart, and https://www.nfl.com/teams/new-england-patriots/depth-chart returned a rendered '404 - Flag on the Play.' page on 2026-11-13.
flags.impact: No starter/backup ordering can be cited from the league site, so the second-, third- and fourth-string requirement stays unmet. Club-site chains remain the only official route and are not uniform.

flags.item: Two suggestion registers use different identifiers for the same work
flags.finding: research/nfl/decisions.json ranks ten suggestions as S01-S10; research/nfl-suggestions.json lists twelve as SU-01-SU-12 and is rendered on the sub-site's own Suggestions page. Depth charts are S02 in one and SU-03 plus SU-07 in the other.
flags.impact: Neither register is deleted. A published crosswalk maps each S-id to its SU-ids so a reviewer can follow either, and the reviewer is asked to adopt one register.

flags.item: Validation gates are a declared matrix, not executed tests
flags.finding: nfl_origination/engine.py assigns each candidate strategy a gate string. G01 and G02 are marked pass for snapshot-based candidates and G10 is open for all eight. No statistical test is executed whose outcome could flip a gate; a test asserts the matrix contains the assigned strings.
flags.impact: The page wording is accurate about the matrix, but a reader could infer the gates were run. No strategy is qualified either way, and the empty leaderboard is unaffected.

flags.item: No-information baseline is a 50% forecast, and the baseline rate is not stated
flags.finding: The published Brier comparison sets the model's 0.1575 against 0.25, the Brier score of a flat 50% forecast, across 32 clubs. The unconditional home-win rate in this snapshot is not 50% and the page does not state which rate the reference used.
flags.impact: The direction of the comparison is not in doubt. The reference is under-specified and is not a market comparison, and it is labelled accordingly.

flags.item: An originated line is shown for a fixture that has since kicked off
flags.finding: W10-01 (WAS at NYG, 2026-11-12 20:15 ET) carries an originated spread and total on the line origination page as of 2026-11-13. The gate table marks temporal integrity G02 as a blanket pass for the originated lines.
flags.impact: G02 remains a pass for the thirteen fixtures still unplayed. The retrospective row is labelled, and no result is used to score it.

flags.item: Page metadata describes every NFL page as NBA research
flags.finding: The page template in scripts/build_site.py hard-codes the description 'OWN7 NBA research: source-linked observations, exploratory models...' for all canonical pages, including the NFL landing page and every NFL sub-page.
flags.impact: Search engines and link previews mislabel the NFL section. Fixed by deriving the description per page.

flags.item: Page and question counts were typed as prose and had drifted
flags.finding: The landing page called the origination section eleven pages when it publishes twelve, and four rendered surfaces said 'fourteen questions' while the register holds fifteen. The navigation badge read 10 open items beside a twelve-row register without saying which it counted.
flags.impact: Counts are now derived from the data at build time and a test fails if a rendered count disagrees with its register. The badge states that it counts open items.
